_: The physical world when a scheme is off. mesh_bindings is closed-world: every built node or dressing rule that exists because of a scheme is named here. becomes is a design decision, not a viewer instruction.
generated_by: estate-review package 4, 28 August 2026; nodes measured from out/fawley-estate.glb and props-placement.json

survey.albedo: existing terrain albedo before scheme treatment
survey.trees: Felled survey stems are not reinstated: a tree felled for works remains a factual loss in both worlds, not a reversible rendering option.

Sch_CourtyardPool.label: Courtyard pool house, plant and gym

becomes.ground: existing courtyard fabric remains; the pool asset's own paving and plant go

Sch_CourtyardPool.note: The pool is a proposal inserted into standing courtyard fabric. No terrain grading is baked for it.

Sch_StaffVillage.label: Staff village, Meadows North, 80 beds

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo; no terrain grading is baked for the village

Sch_StaffVillage.note: Three source tree indices are removed by the village footprint. They are not resurrected by a scheme toggle.

Sch_Gatehouses.label: Gatehouses and lodge extensions, staff

becomes.ground: the already-survey terrain under all five gatehouse placements; no separate serving ground node is emitted

Sch_Gatehouses.note: Measured build inventory has no gatehouse hardstanding, kerb, planting or graded-terrain node to bind. Binding shared estate terrain would wrongly hide existing fabric.

Sch_RiverClub.label: River Club Building, Thames Frontage

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo in the formal River Club corridor; existing Long Water water remains

Sch_RiverClub.note: The 116.75 m formal corridor grade, canal copings, swimming works and Club precinct are scheme works. The eighteenth-century canal is existing fabric.

Sch_LongWaterSwim.label: Long Water isolated and treated for swimming

becomes.ground: the existing Long Water and surveyed banks remain; no standalone treatment mesh is currently emitted

Sch_LongWaterSwim.note: This is a modification switch. Any future standalone treatment node must be added to mesh_bindings before it can ship.

Sch_MainHouseWing.label: Main House dining wing, 127 m2 new build

becomes.ground: the existing Main House court and core datum remain; no wing-only ground treatment is emitted

Sch_MainHouseWing.note: The build has no south-wing-specific hardstanding or grade. The shared Main House ground must not be bound to a wing-only switch.

Sch_RidingMezzanine.label: Riding School mezzanine, 230 m2

becomes.ground: standing Riding School and its existing ground remain

Sch_RidingMezzanine.note: The mezzanine modification has no separately emitted geometry.

Sch_FloatingBar.label: Floating Long Water Bar, 75 m2

becomes.ground: existing Long Water water and surveyed banks remain; the floating-bar element is presently built=false

Sch_FloatingBar.note: No bar mesh, approach, mooring or shore treatment is emitted in the measured build. | prop.floating-bar is built=false in the registry (no geometry), so it carries no mesh binding; the scheme is capex-only until it is modelled.

Sch_DayMeetings.label: Day meetings and private dining sold

becomes.ground: no physical geometry belongs to a revenue-only offer

Sch_Club.label: Members' club, 250 capped at GBP 750 a month

becomes.ground: no physical geometry belongs to membership pricing

Sch_Club.note: Revenue-only scheme. This is not a residence-development switch.

Sch_TennisPadel.label: Tennis and Padel Courts

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo; the courts platform is not yet built

Sch_TennisPadel.note: The 33.330 mAOD platform is a recorded design but the current build deliberately leaves the courts on existing terrain.

Sch_SpaGarden.label: Spa Garden

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo under the spa-garden work

Sch_SpaGarden.note: The Spa Garden surface is a scheme proposal over the shared core grade; its off-state requires a local survey overlay rather than hiding the estate-wide core. | survey poplar nodes are not bound: none of the 16 felled stems is a poplar, so spa_planting emits no such mesh.
